title: lantana gracilis
intro: Lantana gracilis, commonly known as the shrub lantana, is a species of flowering plant in the verbena family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds, and to reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Lantana gracilis, such as flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions including antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-viral properties. The plant's bioactive compounds have been reported to possess therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being.
